inventory.inputs: Design pressure and rating (psi); class and well temperatures (°F)
inventory.limits: INSPECTED ONLY. Embedded rating tables and qualification claims are not independently established; no tables are reproduced.
inventory.outputs: Discrete rating; pressure/temperature flags, margin (psi), utilization and passed

inventory.limits: EXECUTED. Conditional ceiling arithmetic; no erosion, multiphase or coefficient qualification.

inventory.inputs: Separate production/annulus rates (m³/s), capacities, upstream pressure and supplied loss (Pa)
inventory.limits: EXECUTED. Annulus capacity is absent only for zero annulus flow. Loss is supplied, not predicted.
inventory.outputs: Unclipped separate rates (m³/s), downstream pressure (Pa), within_capacity flag

inventory.inputs: Absolute pressure/drop (psi), rate (gpm (US)), effective Cv, specific gravity, travel, trim, rangeability, recovery/fluid factors
inventory.interface: liquid_critical_drop; trim_cv; valve_pressure_drop; series_pressure_drop; liquid_choke_flow; ChokeFlow
inventory.limits: INSPECTED ONLY. Liquid-only no-attached-fittings screen; factors require qualification. No gas, flashing, viscosity correction or installed-network solution.
inventory.outputs: Critical drop, valve/series loss (psi), effective Cv, liquid rate (gpm (US)), capped drop (psi) and regime

inventory.inputs: Caller HTTPS source, key, topology/orientation, bores/envelope (m), rating (Pa), range (°C), masses (kg), valve count
inventory.limits: INSPECTED ONLY. No seeded equipment records; source URLs are validated syntactically, not independently qualified.
inventory.outputs: Immutable caller entries; lookup by key; selection by orientation/minimum bore and pressure

inventory.limits: EXECUTED. Homogeneous circular geometry; not flexible-layer properties.
inventory.outputs: Inner diameter (m), annular/bore areas (m²), second moment (m⁴), elastic modulus of section (m³)

inventory.inputs: PipeSection, positive radius (m), elastic modulus and explicit stress limit (Pa)
inventory.limits: EXECUTED. Linear elastic curvature model; default unbounded limit is not used. No contact, ovalization or flexible-layer response.
inventory.outputs: Curvature (1/m), elastic stress (Pa), moment (N·m), utilization and passed

inventory.inputs: Section, material strength/modulus (Pa), pressure (Pa), axial/preload/seating forces (N), moment (N·m), seal diameter (m), usage factor and make-up type
inventory.limits: INSPECTED ONLY. Thin-wall hoop approximation, signed bending treatment, default factors and seal policy need engineering review; no acceptance basis is selected here.
inventory.outputs: Pressure thrust, separating/residual force (N), stress/allowable (Pa), body/seal utilization, governing check, notes and passed

inventory.inputs: Section, heated length (m), temperature change (K or °C difference), expansion coefficient (1/K), modulus (Pa), restraint fraction
inventory.limits: INSPECTED ONLY. Restrained-bar model; geometry stiffness and restraint fraction are supplied assumptions, not solved reactions.
inventory.outputs: Thermal strain, free growth (m), fully restrained stress (Pa), fraction-scaled axial force (N)

inventory.inputs: Rigid, flexible or vertical family enum
inventory.limits: INSPECTED ONLY. Routing metadata; not a sized or qualified product catalogue.
inventory.outputs: Family description, governing-check tags and dynamic flag

inventory.inputs: Eligible specification, homogeneous section, signed radius history (m), modulus (Pa), exposure (years), fatigue factor, SCF, curve/environment
inventory.limits: NOT_EVALUATED. Normal package import reaches the fatigue dependency stack. No histories, qualified curve, environment or hot-spot basis are supplied.
inventory.outputs: Converted stress history (MPa) and native fatigue assessment

inventory.inputs: Dynamic specification, section, name, dry mass/length (kg/m), effective axial stiffness (N), bending/torsional stiffness (N·m²)
inventory.limits: INSPECTED ONLY. No solver is imported or invoked by this mapping. Full model, connections, hydrodynamics and dynamic response remain absent.
inventory.outputs: Offline generic structural fragment (m, tonnes/m, kN, kN·m²)
